title: Portable effect-boundary currentness profile
status: experimental Agent Commons interoperability profile; no production promotion claimed
core_invariant: Historical capability or delegation validity, including durable capability consumption, does not freeze authority state. Currentness is a deny-only prerequisite evaluated against authoritative retained state before consequence and MUST NOT mint, widen, revive, or substitute for local effect authority.
composition_rules: A capability that was validly issued and durably consumed remains historical evidence after authority state changes; consumption does not preserve permission to perform a later effect.

Authority replacement, narrowing, revocation, compromise, expiry, or another locally defined invalidating successor state observed before consequence denies the effect even when earlier capability evidence remains cryptographically valid.

A currentness ALLOW means only that the consulted authority state remains current under this prerequisite; it does not create the local grant, capability, purpose, destination, budget, policy, or runtime permission required for the effect.
The unchanged-authority positive control may allow an effect only when preexisting local effect authority and every other required check are independently valid.
A presented currentness checkpoint older than or inconsistent with the authoritative retained head is not rescued by historical evidence and fails closed for effects requiring currentness.

Currentness evidence must be bound to the security-relevant effect context strongly enough to prevent replay or substitution across principal, capability, intent, plan, policy, or destination boundaries.
Protocol transitions such as A2A, MCP, browser, shell, native API, or local IPC do not reset the currentness requirement or manufacture authority.

source_evidence.description: A6.4 project-authored full development-stack consume -> mutate -> release races covering authority replacement, terminal revocation, unchanged-authority success, and currentness-source failure.
RT-DELEGATION-CURRENTNESS-001 preserves the separate invariant that offline-valid historical delegation is evidence rather than current effect authority.

explicit_non_claims: This profile does not claim PR #1444 is merged, production-promoted, or independently reproduced.
This profile does not claim global rollback resistance, Byzantine currentness, or an externally witnessed deployment vulnerability.
This profile does not define a new authority source or grant execution authority.
This profile does not replace capability signature, TTL, plan, policy, destination, consumption, replay, subject, runtime, or containment checks.
A verified currentness checkpoint is evidence about the consulted retained state, not proof of arbitrary external-world truth.
